title: ulex boivinii var. salzmannii
intro: Ulex boivinii var. salzmannii, commonly known as the Rock Gorse, is a woody shrub native to the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Rock Gorse include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Ulex boivinii var. salzmannii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
